assembly.codigo:
section .data
  msg db "Ola, mundo", 10
section .text
  global _start
_start:
  mov eax, 1      ; sys_write
  mov edi, 1      ; stdout
  mov esi, msg
  mov edx, 11
  syscall
  mov eax, 60     ; sys_exit
  xor edi, edi
  syscall

  def saudar(nome) do
    "Olá, #{nome}!" |> IO.puts()
  end
end
